basic_profile.bio: I'm a high school senior from the Midwest, currently navigating the tricky world of college applications. I'm passionate about computer science and rap music, and I'm always on the lookout for new anime series to binge. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after school and during the weekends. When I'm not online, I'm either playing League of Legends or helping out with my school's coding club. I'm single and focusing on getting into my dream college.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a decent understanding of college application processes, primarily from school workshops and online resources. I'm also self-taught in various coding languages, and I've been learning more about financial aid through forums and family discussions.
